The office of the CEO, ina statement, said it received new voter registration applications from 5.1 lakh people after the

cut-off date of November 28. It said this was over and above the 3,08 lakh new voters added to the roll during the special summary revision in October. 'This trend of unprecedented increase... and that too after 20 days of the last date of receiving claims and objections as scheduled... is unexpected and needs greater scrutiny," the CEO said. "Directions are issued to... scrutinise each and every form strictly as per ECI guidelines. 100% field verification shall be done... to identify the genuine eligible persons, EROs are also conducting personal hearings in doubtful cases as per ECI guidelines," the statement said, adding that eight FIRs had been filed against 24 people for submission of false or tampered documents for obtaining voter IDs.
